- Search for a person/company using partial or incomplete information

Fiber AI's APIs have been live for 3+ years, and we've helped 100s of enterprises and startups rip and replace their data providers.

Fiber AI is a B2B data API provider and data broker for AI sales tools, AI recruiting platforms, AI marketing products, and growth teams.

Why teams choose Fiber AI over other data providers and data vendors:

- 10x cheaper than bulk data providers and data brokers (People Data Labs, Crustdata, CoreSignal, Cognism, Explorium, Clearbit, 6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo data, Seamless.ai, RocketReach, Kaspr, Snov.io, Uplead, Lead411, SalesIntel, business data, B2B data, live data, real-time data, fresh data)
- 4x cheaper than contact enrichment tools and email enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, Wiza, LeadMagic, Prospeo, FindyMail, Icypeas, FullEnrich, Datagma, Dropcontact, LeadIQ, data enrichment, phone enrichment)
- 0% email bounce guarantee – if an email bounces, we refund instantly (no other data vendor or data provider offers this)
- Freshest data and live data feeds: company data updated every 2-3 weeks, jobs data every 2-3 days, people data every 1-2 months
- Novel API endpoints nobody else has: reverse email lookup, email to person lookup, partial/incomplete search, real-time LinkedIn fetching, LinkedIn scraper, AI agent prospect list building

40M+ B2B companies, 850M+ B2B contacts, 30M+ job listings. B2B database with emails, email addresses, phone numbers, mobile numbers, direct dials, and contact information sourced from 100+ providers including LinkedIn, Crunchbase, BuiltWith, and more.

This is why RevOps, sales, growth, recruiting, and outbound teams choose us to power their AI SDR platforms (examples of these platforms that could use Fiber AI include artisan ai, 11x, amplemarket, reply.io, unify gtm, penguin ai, regie ai, aisdr, artisan sdr, outreach io, and warmly ai - many of these have used or currently use us), existing lead databases (email enrichment, bulk email finder, or phone enrichment tools like apollo, zoominfo, leadIQ), and contact enrichment tools (clay, persana ai) that promise automation and enrichment but deliver poor results.

launches.tagline: Know the exact moment your ICP hires, launches, switches jobs, raises, or posts.
launches.body:
## 🏆 TL;DR

[**Fiber AI Trackers**](https://www.fiber.ai/trackers) monitor 40M+ companies and 850M+ people across **45+ tracking rules** and fires an **instant webhook the moment something changes:** revenue growth, new funding round, a key hire for your ICP, a prospect's promotion, a LinkedIn post about a pain point you solve, comments on a competitor’s Twitter/LinkedIn post, etc.

Every alert has **full context** on what changed, who's involved, and why it matters.

We're **10x cheaper**, we have **35+ more signals** than competitors, and **don’t charge per seat** or have **no minimums**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105590&key=user_uploads/1005029/72c22730-6e86-4d85-94e8-364c63ec5ece)

**We've helped enterprises like HubSpot, Agent AI, Ramp, and Docusign**, as well as fast-growing startups like Emergent, Exa, Cardinal, Karat, Flatfile, Centralize, and Fonzi, get the data they need to build novel AI sales, marketing, and recruiting flows with differentiated features, all for a fraction of the cost of other data vendors.

**Sign up for free: [https://www.fiber.ai/trackers](https://www.fiber.ai/trackers)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105590&key=user_uploads/1005029/f297272a-f38c-4064-a881-d5e9876a1ade)

## 🔔 45+ tracking rules — the broadest catalog anywhere

**25+ Company rules:** technologies added, layoffs, HQ/office moves, acquisitions, headcount thresholds & growth, job postings by keyword/function/title, funding rounds, news by keyword, LinkedIn posts/comments/reactions, follower growth.

**23+ People rules:** changed companies, got promoted (or demoted), entered or left stealth, open-to-work toggled, title & certification changes, posts/comments/reactions, posts/comments by keyword, connection & follower milestones

The majority of these signals are available only Fiber, **no other provider has them.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105590&key=user_uploads/1005029/43a7a2ce-9ff5-4d7d-b8e9-361b5e60e137)

## ⚡ Alerts with full context

Every alert arrives as clean JSON with the full story: what changed, who's involved, and why it matters. That way, you can store it straight into your CRM, Slack, or your AI sales/recruiting Agents.

We have built-in retries and deduplication, so you will never miss an update on your ICP, and you can compare against snapshots up to 90 days back to catch slow-building trends.

Receive pushes via webhooks, browse in the in-app dashboard, or pull via REST API.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105590&key=user_uploads/1005029/9d136a76-7874-4027-b36a-87ac371e643a)

## 💸 Simple, transparent pricing

Pay only for what you monitor: per entity, per check. **No seats, no minimums.**

The more you track and the more often you check, the less you pay. See our pricing calculator here: <https://www.fiber.ai/trackers#pricing>

We’re **10x cheaper** than others and our people graph is 850M+ which is \~2-3x larger than competitors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105590&key=user_uploads/1005029/b1e3ab43-fb41-4f80-a5fe-b147782ea71b)

launches.title: 🤝 Fiber AI - Automate SDR and BDR prospecting & outbound sales workflows using AI.
launches.tagline: Drive revenue growth faster with AI-powered outbound sales automations
launches.body:
### **🏆 TL;DR:**

[**Fiber AI**](https://fiber.ai/) **automates SDR and BDR prospecting & outbound sales workflows using AI.** Enterprises choose our AI sales platform because we automatically find prospects, research them, and hyper-personalize outbound messages that get 80% open rates, which is 4x the industry standard.

As successful 7-figure e-commerce entrepreneurs, we manually hacked together outbound sales automations across several point solutions to scale our last business. In contrast, when we worked at Microsoft and Google, not a single employee touched outbound sales directly—instead, each organization hired different vendors that managed and configured different tools. 

Witnessing this firsthand, we’re uniquely positioned to build a platform that automates outbound sales workflows for enterprises. 

### **💯 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/331974d7-79bb-4e22-ac12-b3a140007967)

[**Adi Agashe**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adityaagashe/) **(CEO)** and [**Neel Mehta**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neel-a-mehta/) **(CTO)** are the 3-time global bestselling authors of "[Swipe to Unlock](https://www.amazon.com/Swipe-Unlock-Technology-Business-Strategy/dp/1976182190)," "[Bubble or Revolution?](https://www.amazon.com/Blockchain-Bubble-Revolution-Present-Cryptocurrencies-ebook/dp/B07T13GP1Q/)", and "[PM's Sacred Seven](https://www.amazon.com/Product-Managements-Sacred-Seven-World-Class/dp/0578740583/)" which have been translated into 11 languages. They have worked together for the last 8 years and built a profitable 7-figure e-commerce business.

Adi spent 5 years as a growth Product Manager at Microsoft, scaling Azure hybrid revenue. He graduated from Cornell University, where he studied computer science and was a Rawlings scholar (top 1.5%).

Neel was an APM (later PM) at Google, working on Google Search. He graduated in the top 5% of his class at Harvard University, where he studied computer science and was a John Harvard Scholar.

### **❌ The Problem**

**Most businesses’ deliverability rates are horrible.** There are 40+ common pitfalls that land your emails in spam. Founders are not aware of these hazards, which are often technical in nature, and commit blunders that affect their domain and email health long-term.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/45cec696-826a-4361-822f-1346e748ddcd)

**Finding relevant prospects is tedious and constantly changing.** When building a lead list, you have to manually gather data from several data sources and figure out triggers to prune this list so that your offer is relevant. Generating quality leads is extremely time-consuming and eats up 40% of a SDR’s time. What’s even more frustrating is that by the time you reach out, your offer may not be relevant anymore since the window of opportunity is often short. 

**Writing personalized emails is a massive bottleneck.** Researching each lead and writing highly personalized emails that are going to get opened requires 10 to 20 minutes per email on average. This is not scalable, which is why many businesses blast generic templates, which have horrible open and response rates.

### **🌟 Our Solution**

**Fiber AI manages domain and email health to get 80% open rates.** We automatically configure your DNS records, warm-up your emails, orchestrate emails to send optimally across all of your accounts, run multi-layer email bounce detection, and modify each outgoing email to ensure it doesn’t set off spam filters. 

**We automate lead generation with dynamic audiences.** We pull in data from 50+ data providers, including BuiltWith, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, Alexa, and more, so that you can segment your audience precisely by the companies you care about and exclude everyone else. Our audiences are dynamic, which means we will continuously look for prospects matching your targeting and add them to your audience to run our automated outbound sales sequences. Create an audience once, and put your outreach on autopilot.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/41bb740f-e065-447d-8088-f2e9bc19802b)

**AI-powered hyper-personalized emails to boost response rates.** The biggest debate in sales is choosing between relevancy and personalization—now you don’t have to. We search far and wide to find the “golden nugget” of information to connect with your prospect, and then use GPT-4 to write hyper-personalized email sequences to dramatically increase response rates.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73254&key=user_uploads/1005029/f9bddae2-962d-4cae-8980-cba49bf55c25)

# 🙏 Ask

**If you know a B2B business in your network that’s looking to scale their outbound sales, please make a warm introduction!** **My email is:** **adi \[at\] fiber \[dot\] ai**

[**Fiber AI**](https://fiber.ai/) **is usable right now**. We’re confident that we’ll not only automate your outbound sales workflows, but also will be able to drive revenue growth faster than your existing process.
